title: Brewers clinch fourth straight NL Central title, September 16
dek: Milwaukee defeated Pittsburgh 5-1 on September 16, 2026, clinching their fourth consecutive NL Central crown. The result, combined with Chicago's loss to Atlanta, secured the title. Jacob Misiorowski pitched five scoreless innings in the clinch game.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: The Brewers are the first franchise in the NL Central's 32-year history to win four consecutive division titles.
bottom_line: Milwaukee finishes the regular season in 11 remaining games with a chance to reach 97 wins and match the franchise record set last year. A 100-win season would mark the first in the NL Central since the Cubs won 103 games in 2016.
body:
The Milwaukee Brewers clinched their fourth consecutive NL Central title on September 16, 2026, with a 5-1 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates at PNC Park. The Chicago Cubs' 6-3 loss to the Atlanta Braves sealed the division for Milwaukee.
The Brewers are the first franchise in the NL Central's 32-year history to win four years running, according to MLB.com. Milwaukee has won the division five of the last six years and six of the last nine.
Jacob Misiorowski, the 24-year-old right-hander, delivered five scoreless innings in the clinch game, allowing five hits and one walk while striking out seven. He struck out the first four batters he faced and five of the first six. Misiorowski has a 1.89 ERA, leading Major League Baseball, and has recorded 243 strikeouts this season, also the most in the sport. His 166 1/3 innings pitched mark a career high. Per MLB.com, Misiorowski has passed Teddy Higuera's single-season franchise record of 240 strikeouts, set in 1987, for the third-most in Brewers history.
Luis Lara and Joey Ortiz drove in two runs apiece from the bottom third of the batting order. Ortiz, reported by MLB.com as a rookie who arrived in July and was moved from shortstop, contributed to the clinch effort. The Brewers' record stands at 94-57 with 11 games remaining. Milwaukee's franchise record for wins is 97, set last year.
The Brewers are attempting to hold off the Los Angeles Dodgers, Tampa Bay Rays, Atlanta Braves, and New York Yankees for the best record in baseball and home-field advantage throughout the postseason, according to the source. Pat Murphy, the team's manager, told reporters that the 2026 club has not had a clear moment where the team can say "we're really special," but "it's starting to grow on me," per MLB.com. Matt Arnold, the president of baseball operations, stated: "These things never get old, and doing it four years in a row with these guys means the world to me and everyone here." Brandon Woodruff, the staff veteran, said of Misiorowski: "I think we get a little desensitized to what he does on the mound every five days. We've never seen anybody like him. We're getting ready for October, and he's going to lead the way for us."
Misiorowski has delivered in three signature moments this season. According to MLB.com, he pitched the Brewers into first place for good in May with a win over the Cubs at Wrigley Field, secured the best record in Major League Baseball in August with a victory over the Dodgers at Dodger Stadium, and now clinched the division. Owner Mark Attanasio recalled his first visit to PNC Park in 2005, the final series of the season after he purchased the franchise from the Selig family. The Brewers won the opener to end a streak of 12 consecutive losing seasons but lost the next two games and finished 81-81.
